Based on the provided abstract, the study is a comprehensive two-part review paper summarizing theoretical models and observational findings regarding dust formation sources (primarily supernovae, asymptotic giant branch stars, and subsequent ISM reprocessing) and evolution at redshifts $z > 4$. 

The candidate hypothesis introduces highly specific empirical claims, quantitative criteria, and observational methodology (such as spatial offsets between FIR and UV emissions indicating a dual-phase regime with $\ge 50\%$ obscured star formation, CCSNe with explosion energies $> 30\text{ foe}$, and specific ALMA/JWST proposals) that are not proposed or evaluated as the hypothesis of this review paper.

VERDICT: REJECT
